reviews.title: Stop working
reviews.text:
After software update recently this app stop working on my phone. 
I love this app so much, I’m so disappointed.

reviews.title: Missing information
reviews.text: I’ve been using this app for years to track my multiple jobs. I just updated it two days ago. I logged in today and all of my past and future shifts and notes have been deleted.

reviews.title: 2-weeks payments!
reviews.text: Not everyone gets paid weekly! more diversity pls

reviews.title: Why is there music and a woman breathing deeply and typing on this app now?!
Boo to the latest update!
reviews.text: Been using this app for over 10 years. Was wonderful. This latest update is awful though. No longer a nice calendar with color coded shifts. Has smaller print, harder to see and decipher. Shame.
